file(STRINGS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/SHA256SUMS" KNMON_ZSTD_HASHES)
foreach(entry IN LISTS KNMON_ZSTD_HASHES)
    string(SUBSTRING "${entry}" 0 64 expected)
    string(SUBSTRING "${entry}" 66 -1 path)
    file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${path}" actual)
    if(NOT actual STREQUAL expected)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned zstd dependency hash mismatch: ${path}")
    endif()
endforeach()
file(GLOB sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS lib/common/*.c lib/compress/*.c lib/decompress/*.c)
add_library(knmon-zstd STATIC ${sources})
target_include_directories(knmon-zstd SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib")
target_compile_definitions(knmon-zstd PRIVATE ZSTD_DISABLE_ASM ZSTD_LEGACY_SUPPORT=0)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_definitions(knmon-zstd PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
endif()
